meal.title: Store a value in a variable
meal.objective: Assign a value to a name so it can be reused later

voice.script: What if you could store a name and reuse it forever? How do you keep a value for later use? A variable is a named container that holds a value. You give the container a name with an equals sign, putting the value on the right side. Here’s the code that creates a variable and prints it. name. Remember, a variable lets you name and reuse data. Now try this: Create a variable called age, assign your age, and print it.
